title: GEMglPolygonOffset
description: set the scale and units used to calculate depth values

messages.description: scale factor for a variable depth offset per polygon
constant depth offset, in implementation-specific units

arguments.description: scale factor for a variable depth offset per polygon
constant depth offset, in implementation-specific units

body: [GEMglPolygonOffset] calls glPolygonOffset() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glPolygonOffset in the OpenGL reference.
